settings.text: Crafted from 100% muslin cotton, this night dress is naturally breathable and skin-friendly, making it perfect for all-night comfort. The lightweight muslin weave allows air to flow freely, keeping you cool on warm nights, while its ultra-soft texture gently caresses the skin with a soothing, cloud-like feel. Ideal for sensitive skin, it combines everyday ease with a touch of luxury.

This night dress is tailored in a loose, flowy silhouette that moves with you, offering complete freedom and ease. Its button-down front adds a touch of classic charm while making it simple to slip on and off. Available in a palette of soothing pastel shades, it’s the perfect blend of everyday comfort and understated elegance.
